high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a social media post from an account named "sciencefunfacts9." The post is from London, United Kingdom, as indicated at the top of the post. The content of the post is about the nearest black hole to Earth. Text Content: The main text reads: "Nearest black hole to Earth is about 1,000 light years away in the Constellation Telescopium." Below that, it states: "That might not sound very close, but on the scale of the Universe, it's actually right next door." 2
